title: Customer Acquisition via Display Advertising Using Multi-Armed Bandit Experiments
authors: Eric M. Schwartz; Eric T. Bradlow; Peter S. Fader
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Multi-armed bandit field experiment allocating display-ad impressions across creatives and placements (Thompson sampling with hierarchical logit), plus counterfactual policy simulations.
design_notes: R code fits hierarchical/latent-class logit models of conversions by placement x creative and simulates allocation policies (main_run_file.r, policy2res.r, Greedy_variant_policies_201505.r). No regression with unit and time FE.
data_files_note: Aggregated impression/conversion counts for 532 placement-creative pairs; site and placement IDs coded (j101, p101).
screener_notes: No article text available locally; abstract and code are unambiguous.
